label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. Giving them four stars because they were good value and did a lot of things well, but there were a couple of issues worth mentioning if you’re booking a move.

The quote was €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours. Mine was a two-bed flat, though it was mostly my own stuff being moved, and the new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift. Other quotes I’d got were €450 upwards, so theirs was the best value I found. The job took about three and a half hours. I booked through the website and paid a €50 deposit by Revolut, which was straightforward.

The main downside was the start time. They were booked for 9am and arrived at 10.30. Dessie did text at 8.40 to say the previous job had overrun, so I wasn’t left wondering whether they were coming, but it was still an hour and a half sitting on boxes with a cold coffee. It didn’t cause a major problem for me in the end, but if you’ve a tight handover time with a landlord or need to be out by a particular hour, it’s worth bearing in mind. In fairness, Dessie knocked €40 off afterwards for the delay without me asking, which I appreciated.

Once they got going, the lads worked hard. Four floors of stairs is no small job, and there was a bit of a moment when the couch wouldn’t get around the turn on the third floor. One of the lads had an Allen key in his pocket, took the legs off and got it straight in. That was a relief, because I was already wondering what on earth I was going to do with a couch stuck halfway up the building.

They also put the bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want. Those were genuinely helpful extras at the end of a move, when you’re tired and still have everything to sort out.

The other disappointment was a chip to the base of my brass floor lamp. They used blankets on the other furniture, but the lamp wasn’t wrapped. It was my nanny’s, so I was a bit gutted about that even though the damage was small. I’d definitely ask for lamps and anything sentimental to be wrapped separately if booking again. Wrap the lamps, lads!

Overall, I would use them again. The price was good, they dealt with the awkward stairs and couch, and the help with the bed and unwanted shelf made life easier. The delay and the chipped lamp are why it’s four stars rather than five, but I was happy with the move overall. A bit more care with the fragile bits and a more reliable arrival time would have made the difference.
